_doc: Round 4 of the rebuilt-wing angles (same criteria). mp45_w5 (front main + flap -5 deg from y 0.20 to 0.43, 0 at 0.50) attached the front wing at y 0.20-0.40, but its main plane separated outboard where the cut ends: suction side 44-62 % reversed at y 0.45-0.55 and 36-50 % at 0.55-0.65 (w4: 8-26 %, w1: 6-16 %), from mid-chord at y 0.50. -> mp45_w6: the same -5 deg from y 0.20 to the tip (0.69), ramp from 0 at 0.16. Rear wing at the model angles (w5: 2.7 % suction reversed). The front-wing load oscillates +-12 % around its mean (ClA 0.77-0.95 over the last 600 iterations), so single-snapshot separation maps move from run to run; the mean front-wing ClA is 0.86-0.89 in w1, w4 and w5.
